selected_bottleneck: run-durable-id-binding-integrity（持久化运行 ID 绑定完整性）
selected_problem: Fresh canonical main selects a durable run file by the caller-supplied runId, but RunStore.get returned the JSON body without proving that the body's own id still matched that selected artifact. Rewriting only run.id left the storage address unchanged while update/addEvidence and audit-facing identity could diverge from the run actually selected.（最新主分支按调用方传入的 runId 选择持久化运行文件，但 RunStore.get 未证明 JSON 内部 id 仍与被选工件一致；仅改写 run.id 即可保持存储地址不变，却让后续更新、证据写入及审计身份与实际选中的运行分裂。）
decision_basis: The run id is already both the storage selector and the canonical in-document identity used throughout NorthStarRunner, so binding the body back to the selected file preserves existing semantics rather than introducing a new trust model.（运行 id 已同时是存储选择器与 NorthStarRunner 全链路使用的文档内身份，本轮只是绑定两者，不引入新的信任模型。）

A bounded real-file replay directly reproduced the mismatch: the pre-fix loader accepted a run JSON body whose id differed from the requested file id.（有界真实文件重放直接复现：修复前加载器接受内部 id 与请求文件 id 不一致的运行 JSON。）

The immediately preceding autonomous cycle closed the identical storage/body identity gap for durable changesets, making the run-store gap a fresh-main consistency defect rather than a new architectural choice.（上一自主周期刚闭合持久化 changeset 的同类存储/文档身份裂缝，因此 run-store 属于最新主分支上的一致性缺陷，而非新架构选择。）
changes: Make RunStore.get fail closed with RUN_ID_MISMATCH when a durable run document's id differs from the requested artifact id.（当持久化运行文档内部 id 与请求工件 id 不一致时，RunStore.get 以 RUN_ID_MISMATCH 失败关闭。）

Because update/addEvidence and NorthStarRunner reads already load through get, the same identity proof now precedes those mutations without duplicating policy.（update/addEvidence 与 NorthStarRunner 读取均已经通过 get，因此同一身份证明自动前置于这些操作，无需重复策略。）
Add a regression covering rewritten durable ids while preserving normal get/update behavior for intact runs.（新增持久化 id 改写回归，同时证明正常运行仍可读取和更新。）

truth_boundary: This binds the durable run document's declared id to its selected storage identity. It does not authenticate coherently rewritten run metadata/content, add signatures/MACs, or claim crash-safe persistence.（本轮只绑定持久化运行文档声明 id 与存储选择身份；不认证可一致改写的其他运行元数据/内容，不引入签名或消息认证码，也不声称崩溃安全持久化。）
